title: You Can See Everything Rotten Tomatoes score? Above 99
rules: If You Can See Everything has a Tomatometer score of above 99 on Oct 19, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The "Fresh!" and "Certified Fresh!" subtitles are meant for illustrative purposes only. The Tomatometer score must be above the strike value to resolve as YES (for example, a score of 75 would resolve "Above 75" as No.) The market will be determined the Monday after wide release at 10:00 AM ET.

This market and these products have not been endorsed by Rotten Tomatoes. Any references to Rotten Tomatoes or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Rotten Tomatoes and Kalshi.

blind.reasoning: The film currently sits at 100% on Rotten Tomatoes from about 22 reviews, with a 98 Metacritic score and no mixed or negative reviews. But resolution requires it to stay perfect through release week, when the review count will likely grow to around 100 or more. A long, ethically divisive Elizabeth Holmes documentary is likely to draw at least one negative review, and most festival darlings that open at 100% end up at 95-99%.
blind.falsifier: The film still shows 100% with 100+ reviews on Oct 19, 2026 (or, conversely, any single rotten review appearing before then confirms the NO lean).

final.reasoning: The market at 23.5% is close to my estimate; traders likely see a more current review count than my 22-review snapshot, so I moved toward them. What's left is a gap of under three points, too small to act on given how uncertain the forecast is.
